note: Versioned pipeline registry (safe-versioning policy, docs/15). Select the active pipeline with ONE value (env PIPELINE_MODE overrides `active`), never by editing source. PRODUCTION = `legacy`: Higgsfield generates the whole image INCLUDING the ring, from the approved geometry-locked prompts; the preserved logo is still composited locally (docs/04 P0) and cloth neutralised locally (whiten_cloth.py). Set by explicit, repeated user instruction 2026-07-21 ('use only Higgsfield', 'do not ask again'): the user wants Higgsfield to generate every frame - including worn lifestyle/close-up shots that `composite-v1` cannot produce (it can only composite studio angles the 2D CAD covers). This REVERSES the 2026-07-20 composite-v1 switch. Geometry/logo/cloth fidelity under `legacy` is enforced by the strong locked prompts + QC + local logo/cloth compositing + iteration, NOT guaranteed by construction (see QUALITY_MEMORY.json#composite-v1-production-lock, updated 2026-07-21). Higgsfield remains the sole engine either way (docs/21). `composite-v1` is retained intact for optional studio-only geometry-guarantee, NOT production. Neither version switches automatically - only explicit user instruction.

policy.active_activation: legacy IS PRODUCTION BY EXPLICIT, REPEATED USER INSTRUCTION 2026-07-21 ('use only Higgsfield', 'do not ask again'). This supersedes the 2026-07-20 composite-v1 switch: the user wants Higgsfield to generate every frame, including worn lifestyle/close-up shots composite-v1 cannot produce. Deliberate, user-ordered production baseline. Automatic switching between versions remains forbidden in both directions; only an explicit user instruction may change `active`. composite-v1.description: RETAINED, NOT PRODUCTION (user-instructed 2026-07-21). Higgsfield renders only the scene; the real source-CAD ring is composited in - geometry identical by construction, but ONLY for studio angles the 2D CAD covers; it cannot produce worn lifestyle/close-up shots. Kept intact for optional studio geometry-guarantee; not selected automatically.

legacy.description: PRODUCTION (user-instructed 2026-07-21: 'use only Higgsfield'). The original Higgsfield MCP lifecycle that generated the approved catalogs: Higgsfield renders the scene AND the jewelry from the approved geometry-locked prompts; the preserved logo is composited locally afterwards (docs/04 P0 - AI never renders the logo) and cloth neutralised locally. Geometry is NOT guaranteed by construction; it is held by the strong locked prompts (e.g. 'EXACTLY 4 claw prongs, not eight - count them'), per-shot QC, and iteration. Produces every frame type including worn lifestyle/close-ups. This is the user's chosen production baseline.

terminology.Higgsfield: The only production image generation engine (docs/21) - unchanged by the 2026-07-20 switch. Higgsfield renders the scene in BOTH versions; compositing preserved pixels is not generation (docs/21 §2).
terminology.Composite-first: `composite-v1`. Higgsfield renders only the scene; the real source-CAD ring is composited in - geometry identical by construction, but studio angles only. RETAINED, not production (user-instructed 2026-07-21).
terminology.Logo compositing: NOT a pipeline. The preserved logo is composited locally in BOTH versions - required by docs/04 P0 in all cases and unaffected by this switch.
terminology.note: Both versions call Higgsfield. The distinction is whether Higgsfield draws the RING. Production = legacy = Higgsfield generates every frame including the ring (user-instructed 2026-07-21: 'use only Higgsfield'); fidelity held by locked prompts + QC + local logo/cloth, not by construction.
